articleBody:
Getting ready to paint the interior of your Albany home? Fantastic! But before you even think about opening a paint can, there’s some crucial prep work to do. Skipping these steps is one of the most common reasons paint jobs don't look professional or last as long as they should. A little upfront effort makes a huge difference in the final result.

Here's a checklist to help Albany homeowners prepare their walls for painting:

- [ ] **Identify existing coatings and surface conditions** — why it matters: Knowing what's already on your walls helps determine if you need special primers or if there are adhesion issues to address.
- [ ] **Check for moisture, peeling, or damaged surfaces** — why it matters: Painting over these problems will only make them worse; paint won't adhere properly to damp, loose, or damaged areas.
- [ ] **Protect floors and fixtures with drop cloths and tape** — why it matters: This prevents accidental drips, spills, and overspray on your valuable flooring, trim, and light fixtures, saving you hours of cleanup.
- [ ] **Clean and degrease all surfaces thoroughly** — why it matters: Dust, grime, and grease prevent paint from bonding correctly, leading to uneven finishes and peeling over time.
- [ ] **Fill holes and cracks with appropriate spackle or caulk** — why it matters: Smooth surfaces are key for a professional look; paint won't hide imperfections, it often accentuates them.
- [ ] **Sand or abrade glossy surfaces where appropriate** — why it matters: This creates a 'tooth' for the new paint to grip onto, especially important when painting over existing glossy finishes.
- [ ] **Apply primer as needed (especially for color changes or repairs)** — why it matters: Primer ensures better adhesion, hides previous colors or stains, and provides a uniform base for your topcoats, improving paint coverage and durability.
- [ ] **Ensure adequate ventilation during and after preparation** — why it matters: Proper airflow helps surfaces dry faster and dissipates fumes from cleaning agents, spackle, and primer.

### How to use this checklist
Go through each item before you start painting. Tick them off as you complete them to make sure you haven't missed anything. This thorough preparation will ensure your paint job looks fantastic and lasts for years to come. It’s the secret to a truly professional finish.
